Statement.justification: needed to authenticate the image pull. Real AWS only accepts Resource * for this action; simaws scopes it to the one registry, and a real deployment would carry that single documented exception.
read-only pull of this service's own repository so the task can start; no push, no other repository, so a compromised task cannot tamper with or read other images
append-only output to its own log group so each run is auditable; no read or delete, so the task cannot erase its trail
REAL-DEPLOYMENT SHAPE, NOT ENFORCED BY THE SIMULATOR: the task calls one named model and nothing else; no ListFoundationModels, no model management, no wildcard model
